name: HYDRA-UMC-UPDATER
build: Detects local projects, compares their manifests with GitHub and performs explicit install or update actions.
notes: Administrative tooling for the ecosystem catalog. It has its own manifest but is intentionally excluded from the 46-product public dashboard count. Real bounded retry with backoff for transient GitHub network errors; a malformed remote catalog fails loudly (caught by both gui.py and main.py, falling back to local-only state) while one malformed manifest is isolated without aborting discovery of the rest. install.py's clone_or_pull never replaces a healthy local checkout - pull is always --ff-only, never a reset.
